newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean BOK offers to sell dlrs in forward trade.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean BOK offers to sell dlrs in forward trade.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea was seen offering to sell dollars in forward trading during Tuesday's afternoon session to slow the U.S. unit's climb against the local currency, dealers said.
The central bank offered to sell $30 million each at 896.50 won in three-month forward trading and at 911.00 won in six-month forward trading, they said.
The central bank has refused to comment on talk of its intervention in interbank trading.
Shortly after the offer, the won was trading at 882.50 against the dollar on the spot market. It opened the day at 881.50.
